agent_session_owner_check.name: agent_session_owner_check
agent_session_owner_check.value: (owner_kind = 'user' and user_id is not null and key_id is null) or (owner_kind = 'key' and key_id is not null and user_id is null)

agent_session_attached_task_check.name: agent_session_attached_task_check
agent_session_attached_task_check.value: attached_task_id is null or attached_plan_id is not null

agent_session_summary_check.name: agent_session_summary_check
agent_session_summary_check.value: (summary is null and summary_fingerprint is null) or (summary is not null and summary_fingerprint ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

agent_session_collection_manifest_check.name: agent_session_collection_manifest_check
agent_session_collection_manifest_check.value: (collection_expected_batches is null and collection_path_count is null and collection_content_hash is null) or (collection_id is not null and collection_expected_batches >= 0 and collection_path_count >= 0 and collection_content_hash is not null)

agent_session_collection_complete_check.name: agent_session_collection_complete_check
agent_session_collection_complete_check.value: not collection_complete or collection_content_hash is not null

plan_created_by_check.name: plan_created_by_check
plan_created_by_check.value: (created_by_kind = 'user' and created_by_user_id is not null and created_by_key_id is null) or (created_by_kind = 'project_key' and created_by_key_id is not null and created_by_user_id is null)

task_claim_check.name: task_claim_check
task_claim_check.value: (claimed_by_session_id is null and claimed_at is null and lease_expires_at is null) or (claimed_by_session_id is not null and claimed_at is not null and lease_expires_at is not null)

task_created_by_check.name: task_created_by_check
task_created_by_check.value: (created_by_kind = 'user' and created_by_user_id is not null and created_by_key_id is null) or (created_by_kind = 'project_key' and created_by_key_id is not null and created_by_user_id is null)

event_actor_check.name: event_actor_check
event_actor_check.value: (actor_kind = 'user' and actor_user_id is not null and actor_key_id is null) or (actor_kind = 'project_key' and actor_key_id is not null and actor_user_id is null) or (actor_kind = 'system' and actor_user_id is null and actor_key_id is null and actor_session_id is null)

tracker_scan_through_sha_check.name: tracker_scan_through_sha_check
tracker_scan_through_sha_check.value: (kind = 'git_history' and through_sha ~ '^[0-9a-f]{40}$') or (kind = 'backlog' and through_sha is null)
